Captain Shubman Gill Returns to Batting Practice After Injury

Indian cricket captain Shubman Gill has returned to batting practice in a practice match against Sri Lanka XI in Colombo, following an injury. He opened the batting with Yashasvi Jaiswal. Sri Lanka XI declared their second innings at 200/6, setting India a target of 207 runs. Gill's return is seen as a significant relief for the Indian team ahead of their Test series against Sri Lanka.
